_readme: Partner romance arcs: one list of beats per partner key (from characters.json). A beat fires every few weeks once her trust is high enough; the last beat makes her Sam's lover.
Beat: title, scene (image scene: sam_date, shower, walkin, casual, portrait, bath, or final = her private scene with Sam), text, choices.
Choice: label plus effects. t/m/l = trust/mood/lewdness change. res = result text ({N} = her name). hold:true = the beat comes back later instead of advancing.
Extra effects: gold (negative = cost; add cantAfford:{...} for when Sam is short), sam:{strength:1} (Sam stat), energy:"full", health:20, grow:{service:6} (her skill).
Conditions: if:{lewd:40} (her stat at least that; also supports trust, mood, intim, ngpp, canAct:[...], canNext:true) uses this choice's effects or hides/branches to else:{...}.

Intimacy & private time: byIntim:{"1":{...},"3":{...}} overrides beat text/choices at w.intim >= tier; choice private:true triggers privateCore with acts:[...], optional cross stage unlock, and goLead text on beat 6 final.
NG++ déjà vu: ngpp can be a 3-element array [tier0, tier1, tier2] or {tier: text} appended on NG++ runs based on how many cycles she has returned.

image (optional): {comp, setting, sam, pov, towel, bath, cloth, wear} a picture for that beat instead of the generic scene (cloth/wear: what the text says she has on, see scenes.json _readme). A byIntim variant can carry its own image, laid over the beat image (give just what differs); a variant without one shows the generic scene.
